{"predictors": [
  {"name": "Long-Term Asset Growth Volatility", "construction": "Calculate the standard deviation of annual percent changes in total assets over the past 7 years using Compustat annual data.", "rationale": "Firms with stable growth in assets may reflect disciplined capital allocation, while volatile asset growth could signal inconsistent strategy or response to industry shocks.", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"},
  {"name": "Cash Flow Persistence", "construction": "Regress quarterly operating cash flows on a constant over the past 16 quarters; use the R-squared as the measure.", "rationale": "Persistent cash flows suggest a more predictable and durable business model, which may be underappreciated by the market.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
  {"name": "Relative Supplier Concentration", "construction": "Divide purchases from the top supplier (from 10-K supply chain disclosures) by total COGS in the most recent fiscal year.", "rationale": "Dependence on a single supplier can expose firms to operational risks that might not be priced in.", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"},
  {"name": "Cumulative Insider Trading Net Value", "construction": "Sum net purchases (buys minus sells) by all insiders over the past 12 months from SEC Form 4 filings, scaled by market capitalization.", "rationale": "Insiders have superior information about future firm prospects and their net buying may signal undervaluation.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
  {"name": "Dividend Smoothing Score", "construction": "Standard deviation of annual dividend per share changes over the past 10 years, divided by average earnings per share over the same period.", "rationale": "Stable dividend policies may indicate management confidence and financial discipline, attracting longer-term investors.", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"},
  {"name": "R&D Capitalization Ratio", "construction": "Ratio of accumulated R&D expense over the past 5 years to total assets, with R&D accumulated as if it were capitalized and depreciated linearly over 5 years.", "rationale": "Firms investing heavily in R&D may be underappreciated if the market treats R&D as an expense rather than an investment.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
  {"name": "Patent Application Intensity", "construction": "Count of patent applications in the past 3 years from USPTO data, divided by total assets.", "rationale": "High rates of innovation may drive future profitability that is not yet reflected in accounting numbers.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
  {"name": "Lagged Environmental Incident Count", "construction": "Count the number of reported environmental violations or incidents (from EPA records) in the prior 3 years.", "rationale": "Firms with poor environmental track records may face regulatory or reputational risks not fully priced in.", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"},
  {"name": "Supplier Payment Delay Index", "construction": "Average days payable outstanding (DPO) over the past 3 years, from Compustat cash flow and balance sheet data.", "rationale": "Firms delaying payments to suppliers might be experiencing liquidity issues or extracting value from working capital at the cost of long-term relationships.", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"},
  {"name": "Relative Geographic Expansion Rate", "construction": "Count of new international markets entered in the last 5 years (as disclosed in 10-K business segment information), divided by prior 5-year average firm sales.", "rationale": "Aggressive but successful geographic expansion may signal growth opportunities yet to be fully priced.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"}
]}
